import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Stress Level)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter1 = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality')
plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution')

# 3. BMI Category distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=['#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
colors_pie = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax4.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')

# 5. Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
           c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps')

# 6. Heart Rate by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
gender_groups = df.groupby('Gender')['Heart Rate']
positions = [1, 2]
bp = ax6.boxplot([gender_groups.get_group('Male'), gender_groups.get_group('Female')], 
                  labels=['Male', 'Female'], patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], ['lightblue', 'lightpink']):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender')

# 7. Stress Level by Occupation
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
occupation_stress = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax7.barh(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.values, color='coral', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_stress)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(occupation_stress.index, fontsize=8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
ax7.set_title('Stress Level by Occupation')

# 8. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Features')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, y=0.995, fontweight='bold')

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
